title: Films, music, sport & free time
goal: Talk about what you're watching and listening to, review a film or a play, recommend (or warn against) something, follow a cricket or football match, and talk about your hobbies.
intro:
Half of all conversation between friends is about what you watched, what you're listening to and who won last night. In Maharashtra that means Marathi films and web series, Hindi films made down the road in Mumbai, the great Marathi theatre tradition, Ajay–Atul songs blasting at every wedding, and cricket — always cricket.

The grammar is all about **comparing**: better than (**-पेक्षा**), as good as (**-इतका**), the best ever (**आतापर्यंतचा सगळ्यात**), one of the best (**-पैकी एक**) and 'the more…, the more…' (**जितका… तितका…**). And you'll pick up the slang friends use to review things: **भन्नाट!**, **पैसा वसूल!**, **एक नंबर!**

grammar.title: Comparisons in depth: -पेक्षा, -इतका
grammar.body:
You met **-पेक्षा** 'than' in unit 8. Here is everything you need to compare things properly.

**Better / more … than**: X**पेक्षा** + adjective. **जास्त** 'more' is optional, because -पेक्षा already means 'compared to': हा पिक्चर पुस्तका**पेक्षा** (जास्त) चांगला आहे. Before -पेक्षा the noun goes oblique: पुस्तक → पुस्तका-, तिकीट → तिकिटा-.

**Much more**: **खूप / कितीतरी / फार** जास्त: कितीतरी चांगला 'way better'.

**Less … than**: -पेक्षा **कमी**: हा पहिल्यापेक्षा कमी बोअरिंग आहे.

**As … as**: X-**इतका** (agrees with what's being described: इतका / इतकी / इतकं), usually in the negative: दुसरा सीझन पहिल्या**इतका** चांगला नाही 'season two isn't as good as the first'. 'Just as' = **तितकाच**: हा पण तितकाच भन्नाट आहे.

**Rather than doing**: verbal noun -ण्या + पेक्षा: घरी बस**ण्यापेक्षा** पिक्चरला जाऊ 'rather than sitting at home, let's go to a film'. And **त्यापेक्षा** alone = 'instead, I'd rather': वेळ वाया गेला, त्यापेक्षा झोपलो असतो.

The trap: don't add an extra 'more' word in front of the adjective as English does ('more interesting'): just X-पेक्षा मजेशीर.

examples.en: The film is better than the book.

examples.native: मराठी नाटकं हिंदी पिक्चरपेक्षा कितीतरी जास्त भारी असतात.
examples.roman: marāṭhī nāṭakaṃ hindī pikcharpekṣā kitītarī dzāst bhārī astāt.
examples.en: Marathi plays are way better than Hindi films.
The second season isn't as good as the first.
Rather than sitting at home, let's go to a film.
The popcorn cost more than the ticket!

grammar.title: Superlatives: the best, one of the best, the best ever
grammar.body:
**The most / the -est**: **सगळ्यात** (everyday) or **सर्वात** (a bit more formal) + adjective: सगळ्यात चांगला 'the best', सगळ्यात बोअरिंग 'the most boring'. The adjective still agrees: सगळ्यात आवडत**ं** गाणं, सगळ्यात आवडत**ा** खेळाडू.

**The best in / of a group**: put the group in front with **-तला** ('in') or **-पैकी** ('out of'): वर्षा**तलं** सगळ्यात हिट गाणं 'the biggest hit of the year'; सगळ्या थिएटर**पैकी** हे सगळ्यात जुनं 'of all the cinemas, this one's the oldest'.

**One of the**: plural oblique + **पैकी एक**: माझ्या आवडत्या गायकां**पैकी एक** 'one of my favourite singers'. Note the plural oblique -आं-: गायक → गायकां-, गाणं → गाण्यां-; English loans often stay unchanged: थिएटरपैकी, पिक्चरपैकी.

**The best ever**: **आतापर्यंतचा** (lit. 'of up to now') + सगळ्यात…, agreeing with the noun: आतापर्यंतची सगळ्यात चांगली मॅच.

**Casual**: **एक नंबर!** 'number one, the best', **नंबर वन**, **भन्नाट**, **कडक** (Pune) — all said about anything from vada pav to a batting display.

grammar.title: The more…, the more…: जितका… तितका…
grammar.body:
Marathi builds 'the more…, the more…' with the correlative pair **जितका** 'as much as' … **तितका** 'that much' — the same jo/to pattern as जो… तो… and जेव्हा… तेव्हा….

**With verbs or whole ideas** use the neuter: **जितकं** जास्त ऐकतो, **तितकं** जास्त आवडतं 'the more I listen, the more I like it'.

**With a noun**, each word agrees with its own noun: **जितका** जास्त सराव (m), **तितका** चांगला खेळाडू (m); जितकं मोठं स्टेडियम, **तितकी** जास्त गर्दी (f).

**The sooner / the earlier** — the oblique **जितक्या** before लवकर: **जितक्या लवकर, तितकं चांगलं** 'the sooner the better'.

**As X goes on, Y gradually…**: **जसजसा… तसतसा…** (agreeing the same way): जसजशी मॅच पुढे गेली, तसतसं टेन्शन वाढलं 'as the match went on, the tension rose'.

The trap: don't use जास्त जास्त for 'more and more' at the start — the pair जितका… तितका does that job.

examples.native: जितका जास्त सराव कराल, तितकं चांगलं खेळाल.
examples.roman: jitkā dzāst sarāv karāl, titkaṃ tsāṅglaṃ kheḷāl.
examples.en: The more you practise, the better you'll play.

examples.native: जितकं ऐकतो, तितकं मला हे गाणं जास्त आवडतं.
examples.roman: jitkaṃ aikto, titkaṃ malā he gāṇaṃ dzāst āvaḍtaṃ.
examples.en: The more I listen, the more I like this song.

examples.native: जसजशी मॅच पुढे गेली, तसतसं टेन्शन वाढलं.
examples.roman: dzasdzashī mæch puḍhe gelī, tastasaṃ ṭenshan vāḍhlaṃ.
examples.en: As the match went on, the tension rose.

lines.en: Yes, that one! The reviews are good too. People are saying it's totally worth it.

lines.roman: are, mæch tar dar varṣī aste. pikchar thieṭarmadhye phakta don āṭhavḍe!
lines.en: Come on, there's a match every year. The film's only in cinemas for two weeks!

lines.speaker: Aditya
lines.native: भारत-पाकिस्तान मॅचपेक्षा मोठं काहीच नाही. ही आतापर्यंतची सगळ्यात मोठी मॅच असणार.

lines.en: Nothing's bigger than India–Pakistan. This is going to be the biggest match ever.

lines.speaker: Sneha
lines.en: You say that about every match!

lines.speaker: Aditya
lines.en: OK, so the Saturday night show?

lines.speaker: Sneha
lines.native: चालेल! आणि आधीच सांगते, स्पॉयलर बघायचे नाहीत.
lines.roman: tsālel! āṇi ādhīts sāṅgte, spôylar baghāytse nāhīt.
lines.en: Done! And I'm telling you now — no looking up spoilers.

lines.speaker: Aditya
lines.native: आणि तू पिक्चरमध्ये मध्ये मध्ये बोलायचं नाही!
lines.roman: āṇi tū pikcharmadhye madhye madhye bolāytsaṃ nāhī!
lines.en: And no chatting in the middle of the film!

lines.speaker: Sneha
lines.native: मी? तू मॅच बघताना जितकं ओरडतोस, तितकं मी आयुष्यात कधी बोलले नाही!
lines.roman: mī? tū mæch baghtānā jitkaṃ oraḍtos, titkaṃ mī āyuṣyāt kadhī bolle nāhī!
lines.en: Me? I've never talked in my whole life as much as you shout watching a match!

lines.speaker: Aditya
lines.native: ठीक आहे, ठीक आहे. तिकिटं मी बुक करतो.
lines.roman: ṭhīk āhe, ṭhīk āhe. tikiṭaṃ mī buk karto.
lines.en: Fine, fine. I'll book the tickets.

culture:
Maharashtra is the home of Indian cinema — Dadasaheb Phalke made India's first feature film in Mumbai in 1913 — and Mumbai's Hindi film industry is right there, but Marathi has its own thriving cinema (**सैराट**, **नटसम्राट**) and, above all, a theatre culture that is still very much alive: Pune's Balgandharva Rangmandir and Dadar's Shivaji Mandir sell out for new **नाटकं**, and going to a play is a normal weekend plan, not a special occasion. In music, the composer duo Ajay–Atul and the song **झिंगाट** are unavoidable at weddings and processions, and **लावणी** is the classic folk form.

Cricket is everyone's second language: Mumbai's Shivaji Park produced Sachin Tendulkar, and **gully cricket** in housing-society compounds is how most boys (and many girls) grow up. Friends review everything in slang — **भन्नाट**, **झकास**, **एक नंबर**, **कडक** for great; **बकवास**, **डोक्याला ताप** 'a headache' for bad. Kabaddi and kho-kho are home-grown sports with their own leagues, and on weekends Pune's young crowd goes **ट्रेकिंग** to the Sahyadri forts.

tip.title: -पेक्षा, -इतका — comparing
tip.body:
- 'Better than': X**पेक्षा** चांगला (जास्त is optional); 'way better': **कितीतरी** चांगला.
- 'Less … than': X-पेक्षा **कमी**.
- 'As … as': X-**इतका** (agrees): ट्रेलर**इतका** भन्नाट नाही.
- 'Rather than doing': -ण्या**पेक्षा**: रिव्ह्यू वाच**ण्यापेक्षा** स्वतः बघ.

tip.title: सगळ्यात चांगला, … पैकी एक — the best
tip.body:
- 'The most / -est': **सगळ्यात** (or सर्वात) + adjective: सगळ्यात **आवडतं** गाणं.
- 'One of the': plural oblique + **पैकी एक**: आवडत्या गायकां**पैकी एक**.
- 'Best ever': **आतापर्यंतचा** सगळ्यात चांगला.
- Casual: **एक नंबर!** 'the best!'

sentences.roman: tudzhā āvaḍtā gāyak koṇ? mādzhā arijit siṅg.
sentences.en: Who's your favourite singer? Mine's Arijit Singh.

sentences.native: हे गाणं डोक्यातून जातच नाहीये, सकाळपासून ऐकतोय.
sentences.roman: he gāṇaṃ ḍokyātūn dzātats nāhīye, sakāḷpāsūn aiktoy.
sentences.en: I can't get this song out of my head — I've been listening to it since the morning.

sentences.native: हा आतापर्यंतचा सगळ्यात भन्नाट पिक्चर आहे.
sentences.roman: hā ātāparyantsā sagḷyāt bhannāṭ pikchar āhe.
sentences.en: This is the most amazing film ever.

sentences.native: लग्नात सगळ्यात जास्त कोणतं गाणं वाजतं?
sentences.roman: lagnāt sagḷyāt dzāst koṇtaṃ gāṇaṃ vādztaṃ?
sentences.en: Which song gets played the most at weddings?

sentences.native: मराठी गाण्यांपैकी हे सगळ्यात जुनं आहे.
sentences.roman: marāṭhī gāṇyānpaikī he sagḷyāt dzunaṃ āhe.
sentences.en: Of all the Marathi songs, this one's the oldest.

sentences.native: हा गायक एक नंबर आहे!
sentences.roman: hā gāyak ek nambar āhe!
sentences.en: This singer is the best!

sentences.native: आज भारत-ऑस्ट्रेलियाची मॅच आहे.
sentences.roman: ādz bhārat-ôsṭreliyāchī mæch āhe.
sentences.en: It's the India–Australia match today.

sentences.native: स्कोअर काय झाला? दोनशे धावा, चार विकेट.
sentences.roman: skoar kāy dzhālā? donshe dhāvā, tsār vikeṭ.
sentences.en: What's the score? Two hundred for four.

sentences.native: कोण जिंकतंय? अजून सांगता येत नाही.
sentences.roman: koṇ jiṅktaṃy? adzūn sāṅgtā yet nāhī.
sentences.en: Who's winning? Can't tell yet.

sentences.native: आपला कर्णधार आज लवकर आउट झाला.
sentences.roman: āplā karṇadhār ādz lavkar āuṭ dzhālā.
sentences.en: Our captain got out early today.

sentences.native: शेवटच्या ओव्हरमध्ये दहा धावा हव्या होत्या.
sentences.roman: shevaṭchyā ovharmadhye dahā dhāvā havyā hotyā.
sentences.en: They needed ten runs in the last over.

sentences.native: भारत जिंकला! काय मॅच होती!
sentences.roman: bhārat jiṅklā! kāy mæch hotī!
sentences.en: India won! What a match!

sentences.native: आपण शेवटच्या बॉलवर हरलो.
sentences.roman: āpaṇ shevaṭchyā bôlvar harlo.
sentences.en: We lost on the last ball.

sentences.native: तो माझा आवडता खेळाडू आहे, पण आज त्याने एकही धाव काढली नाही.
sentences.roman: to mādzhā āvaḍtā kheḷāḍū āhe, paṇ ādz tyāne ekhī dhāv kāḍhlī nāhī.
sentences.en: He's my favourite player, but today he didn't score a single run.

sentences.native: विकेट पडली!
sentences.roman: vikeṭ paḍlī!
sentences.en: That's a wicket!

sentences.native: मॅच कुठे बघायची? माझ्या घरी या.
sentences.roman: mæch kuṭhe baghāychī? mājhyā gharī yā.
sentences.en: Where shall we watch the match? Come to my place.

lessons.title: Football, fans and the more the merrier

tip.title: जितका… तितका… — the more…, the more…
tip.body:
- **जितका** 'as much as' in the first half, **तितका** 'that much' in the second.
- With a verb or idea: neuter **जितकं… तितकं…**.
- With nouns, each agrees with its own noun: **जितका** मोठा फॅन, **तितकं** जास्त टेन्शन.
- 'The sooner the better': **जितक्या लवकर, तितकं चांगलं**.
- 'As … went on': **जसजसा… तसतसा…**.

sentences.native: जितका जास्त सराव, तितका चांगला खेळाडू.
sentences.roman: jitkā dzāst sarāv, titkā tsāṅglā kheḷāḍū.
sentences.en: The more practice, the better the player.

sentences.native: जितक्या लवकर तिकिटं काढू, तितकं चांगलं.
sentences.roman: jitkyā lavkar tikiṭaṃ kāḍhū, titkaṃ tsāṅglaṃ.
sentences.en: The sooner we book the tickets, the better.

sentences.native: जितका मोठा फॅन, तितकं जास्त टेन्शन!
sentences.roman: jitkā moṭhā fæn, titkaṃ dzāst ṭenshan!
sentences.en: The bigger the fan, the bigger the stress!

sentences.native: जसजशी मॅच पुढे गेली, तसतशी गर्दी वाढली.
sentences.roman: dzasdzashī mæch puḍhe gelī, tastashī gardī vāḍhlī.
sentences.en: As the match went on, the crowd grew.

sentences.native: तो रोनाल्डोचा खूप मोठा फॅन आहे.
sentences.roman: to ronālḍotsā khūp moṭhā fæn āhe.
sentences.en: He's a huge Ronaldo fan.

sentences.native: काल मेस्सीने दोन गोल केले.
sentences.roman: kāl messīne don gol kele.
sentences.en: Messi scored two goals yesterday.

sentences.native: आमच्या सोसायटीत मुलं रोज संध्याकाळी फुटबॉल खेळतात.
sentences.roman: āmchyā sosāyaṭīt mulaṃ rodz sandhyākāḷī fuṭbôl kheḷtāt.
sentences.en: In our society the kids play football every evening.

sentences.native: आमच्या टीमने शेवटच्या मिनिटाला गोल केला!
sentences.roman: āmchyā ṭīmne shevaṭchyā miniṭālā gol kelā!
sentences.en: Our team scored in the last minute!

sentences.native: रोज सराव केल्याशिवाय चांगलं खेळता येत नाही.
sentences.roman: rodz sarāv kelyāshivāy tsāṅglaṃ kheḷtā yet nāhī.
sentences.en: You can't play well without practising every day.

sentences.native: फावल्या वेळात तू काय करतोस? मी गिटार वाजवतो.
sentences.roman: phāvlyā veḷāt tū kāy kartos? mī giṭār vādzavto.
sentences.en: What do you do in your free time? I play the guitar.

sentences.native: मला लहानपणापासून वाचनाचा छंद आहे.
sentences.roman: malā lahānpaṇāpāsūn vātsanātsā chhand āhe.
sentences.en: I've loved reading ever since I was a child.

sentences.native: तुला कोणता छंद आहे?
sentences.roman: tulā koṇtā chhand āhe?
sentences.en: What are your hobbies?

sentences.native: मी यूट्यूबवरून गिटार शिकतोय.
sentences.roman: mī yūṭyūbvarūn giṭār shiktoy.
sentences.en: I'm learning the guitar from YouTube. (man)

sentences.native: ती तबला खूप छान वाजवते.
sentences.roman: tī tablā khūp chhān vādzavte.
sentences.en: She plays the tabla really well.

sentences.native: रविवारी आम्ही सिंहगडला ट्रेकला जातो.
sentences.roman: ravivārī āmhī sinhagaḍlā ṭreklā dzāto.
sentences.en: On Sundays we go trekking to Sinhagad.

sentences.native: रोज अर्धा तास सराव करतो.
sentences.roman: rodz ardhā tās sarāv karto.
sentences.en: I practise for half an hour every day. (man)

sentences.native: फोटोग्राफी हा माझा नवीन छंद आहे.
sentences.roman: foṭogrāfī hā mādzhā navīn chhand āhe.
sentences.en: Photography is my new hobby.
